annotations.title: Explain transaction, decoded: what an EVM transaction did

description: Explain an EVM transaction in plain words: success or revert, sender and contract, ETH value, fee, the function called (decoded for common ERC-20, ERC-721, WETH, permit and multicall calls), and every token transfer, mint, burn and approval it emitted with amounts and symbols, plus one-line summaries. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Use to check what a payment or contract call really did before trusting it or reporting it. Example: hash=0x7d108fa131ed949c76d50caf2e7dfe25fc9903b9d276c40a0446d8afbdfe86b0. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
